reason: Adds an @-triggered file and directory browser to the chat composer, using bounded project-tree listing and inserting selected paths as plain-text references.

summaries.zh: 在聊天输入框中通过@触发受限的项目文件和目录浏览，并将选中的相对路径作为纯文本引用插入草稿。
summaries.en: Adds an @-triggered browser for bounded project files and directories, inserting selected relative paths as plain-text references in the chat draft.

capabilities: Lists bounded project files and directories
Serves the project tree through an HTTP route
Inserts selected relative paths into the chat draft
